resources.string: A floating touchpad for controlling full-screen magnification. It does not read screen content, capture screenshots, inject clicks, or access the internet. Enable only if you want this prototype to control screen magnification.

Hold-to-pan only. Your finger tracks during a short zoom-in ramp. Off restores immediate entry. Sticky taps and double-tap scale adjustment are unchanged. Respects system disabled animations. Not a Bluetooth-mouse delay fix.
